sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
சந்திர பிம்பமோ அன்றி தண்மையின் உருவோ
இந்திர லோகத்து மந்திர ரூபமோ மோக வடிவோ
sections.translit:
chandra bimbamO andRi thaNmaiyin uruvO
indhra lOgatthu mandhira rUpamO mOga vadivO
sections.en: Is she the reflection of the moon, or the embodiment of cool serenity? Is she a celestial princess of Indra’s heaven, or the manifestation of enchantment itself?

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
மையல் தந்திடும் கனியிதழ் காமன் கணையோ
தையல் இவளை படைத்த நாயகன் ஒருவனோ
sections.translit:
maiyal thandhidum kaniyidhazh kAman kaNaiyO
thaiyal ivaLai padaittha nAyagan oruvanO
sections.en: Are her lips the bow of love’s own Cupid, whose arrows kindle desire? Is there only a single divine creator that fashioned this damsel?

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
கயல் விழிதனிலே கனிந்த காதலும்
கடை விழிதனிலே காருண்யமும் நிறைந்து
பரிவுடன் பதம் வருடிடும் பாங்கினில் நெகிழ்ந்து
அறிதுயில் புரிந்திடும் என்முன் அமர்ந்த எழிலிவள்
sections.translit:
kayal vizhidhanilE kanindha kAdhalum
kadai vizhidhanilE kAruNyamum niRaindhu
parivudan padham varudidum pAnginil negizhndhu
aRithuyil purindhidum enmun amarndha ezhilivaL
sections.en: In her pretty fish-like eyes ripens tender love, and in the corner of her gaze dwells gentle compassion. With affection she caresses my feet, and I melt in the grace of this radiant beauty, who is seated in front of me as I remain in constant conscious awareness.

notes: This song extols the beauty and grace of Mahalakshmi, as though Vishnu himself were attempting to compose a few verses of a sequel to Soundarya Lahari, this time with his consort as the focus. He wonders whether Brahma alone could have created her. Even for one well-versed in conscious awareness, he says, her charm, grace, compassion, and devotion lie beyond the reach of comprehension.
